description: This file defines the LogNode interface, which specifies a contract for logging components that can output log messages to various targets and can be chained together to process logs in sequence.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface for a logging node that can output logs and pass them along in a chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to output a log message with a specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable; to be implemented by classes implementing LogNode.
